mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 52 degrees with clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a third quarter moon above; the overnight low will drop to 46 degrees, and we have no rain in the forecast.

October is officially Community Planning Month, where we celebrate our Planning and Development Department for helping our city navigate growth, while residents are also encouraged to participate in the upcoming tri-shaw Bike program at the Senior Center for guided rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.
We have plenty to look forward to, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol and more live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
Regarding local safety, on September 21, officers were dispatched to a retail location on East Verona Avenue where an individual was identified and cited for the theft of Swedish Fish candy.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and you still have time to grab a scoop as the store is open until 10:30 PM.
